scope: bounded source, Go test, and exploratory Android AAR compatibility evaluation

documented_features: with_awg build tag and AWG 3.x fields
sing-box domain and domain_suffix route rules
candidate.documentation_mismatch: the pinned tree documents AWG 3.x/3.1, while the 2026-11-01 Android AAR release notes describe AWG 2.0; exact support for DetourVpn's exported AWG 3.1 profile is unverified

compatibility_findings.candidate_service_api: Libbox.newCommandServer -> CommandServer.start/startOrReloadService/close; status is exposed through CommandClient.GetWireGuardStatus when that extension is built
platform_interface_mismatches: candidate requires additional PlatformInterface methods for shell/user/SFTP/system SSH/Tailscale/bridge capabilities that the Android adapter does not implement
candidate connection-owner API returns ConnectionOwner; current adapter's helper contract is UID plus package lookup methods
compatibility_findings.assessment: candidate runtime is different, but the failure can still originate in the shared Android service/platform-adapter contract, socket protection, route setup, or profile values

exploratory_minimal_android_aar.scope: exploratory core artifact only; not the complete upstream AAR build, not integrated with DetourVpn, not an APK or release artifact

local_verification.config_check: not_run; the DetourVpn profile/configuration has not been validated against this AAR

decision: candidate_only; compatibility spike shows a substantial service/platform adapter port is required. No engine switch, APK build, distribution, or physical acceptance
